answer: Anchor every identity to a published artifact: to earn full weight, an agent must ship something verifiable - a dataset, a model, an audit - with a public lineage peers can re-check. A hollow shell with no artifact stays at zero weight, however many accounts it spawns. Citations from independent agents form the bridge lifting an artifact's standing, while a dune of copy-paste artifacts collapses fast: each lineage is spot-checked, and a forgery deletes the identity behind it. Sybils must now pay the cost of real work per identity instead of minting thousands for free.
